title: JHS Professionals — Medical Billing & RCM Platform
brief: A nationwide US medical billing and revenue cycle management company required an authoritative digital presence to capture practice manager consultation inquiries and rank for competitive state-level healthcare terms.
approach: Engineered a conversion-focused website architecture featuring dedicated specialty and state-level landing pages for local search discovery. Built streamlined one-step consultation capture forms directly in the hero fold and configured end-to-end GA4 and Tag Manager conversion tracking.
outcome: Established organic visibility across target regional healthcare queries while increasing qualified practice manager consultation submissions through friction-free lead capture.
